description: This file implements logging and exception handling functionalities for the Thunder project, including crash reporting, system file logging, and exception catching mechanisms.

classes.name: Instantiation
classes.description: A static class used for registration of log categories during static initialization.

classes.name: ExceptionCatcher
classes.description: A class that implements exception callback to dump exception details and register itself with the thread exception handling system.

methods.name: ForceLinkage
methods.description: A template function to force linkage of the UnknownCallsign symbol.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: Logs the details of an unhandled exception, including call stack information.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: Logs system information from /proc files for debugging purposes.
